SELECT s.region AS 区域, SUM(o.order_amount) AS 销售额
FROM fact_orders o
JOIN dim_store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
WHERE o.bogus_column = 1
GROUP BY s.region
ORDER BY 销售额 DESC
sql_generate:2:
SELECT s.region AS 区域, SUM(o.order_amount) AS 销售额
FROM fact_orders o
JOIN dim_store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
WHERE o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY s.region
ORDER BY 销售额 DESC
